# (build and deps stages as in the previous lesson)
FROM node:24-slim AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
USER node

USER root
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
